steps.title: Prepare to step
steps.cue: Stand upright and begin lifting the stepping foot.
steps.chineseCue: 站稳，开始提起要迈出的脚。
steps.boundaryEvidence: At 2.0s the feet begin to separate; arms stay lowered.

steps.title: Lift the stepping foot
steps.cue: Bring the foot clear of the ground before moving it sideways.
steps.chineseCue: 将迈步脚提离地面，准备向侧面打开。
steps.boundaryEvidence: At 3.0s the stepping knee is raised and the foot is off the ground.

steps.title: Place the foot to the side
steps.cue: Set the lifted foot down to make a wider stance.
steps.chineseCue: 将提起的脚落向侧面，站距打开。
steps.boundaryEvidence: The foot travels outward at 4.0s and is planted by 5.0s.

steps.title: Settle the open stance
steps.cue: Let both legs share the stance as the hands begin to float forward.
steps.chineseCue: 双脚站稳，双手开始向前抬起。
steps.boundaryEvidence: At 6.0s feet are planted; hands start moving forward by 7.0s.

steps.title: Raise both arms
steps.cue: Lift both arms forward to about shoulder height.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂一起向前上方抬至约肩高。
steps.boundaryEvidence: At 8.0s hands rise; at 9.0s they reach upper chest to shoulder level.

steps.title: Bend and lower the arms
steps.cue: Bend the elbows and lower the hands while the knees soften.
steps.chineseCue: 双肘弯曲，手向下落，双膝随之微屈。
steps.boundaryEvidence: Elbows fold at 10.0s; by 11.0s the hands and body have lowered.

steps.title: Finish the downward press
steps.cue: Bring both hands down in front of the hips and settle.
steps.chineseCue: 双手继续落到胯前，完成这一小步。
steps.boundaryEvidence: At 12.0-13.0s hands finish lowering in front of the hips.

steps.title: Round 1: turn and open
steps.cue: Turn the torso as one arm rises and the other opens low.
steps.chineseCue: 身体转动，一臂升高，另一臂向低处打开。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 13.3s hands are low; 14.3s one forearm is raised while the other opens sideways.

steps.title: Round 1: gather foot and arms
steps.cue: Draw the stepping foot in and round the arms in front of the body.
steps.chineseCue: 迈步脚收近，双臂在身前围合。
steps.boundaryEvidence: At 15.8-16.3s the stepping knee is lifted; one arm is high and the other low in front.

steps.title: Round 1: reach with the heel
steps.cue: Extend the lifted leg and touch the heel ahead.
steps.chineseCue: 提起的腿向前伸出，脚跟先落。
steps.boundaryEvidence: At 16.8-17.3s the lifted foot extends forward with its toes raised.

steps.title: Round 1: shift and separate
steps.cue: Move toward the front leg as the front arm opens and the rear hand lowers.
steps.chineseCue: 身体向前腿移动，前臂打开，后手下落。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 17.8s forearms pass near the chest; 18.8s front arm extends and rear hand lowers.

steps.title: Round 1: finish the stance
steps.cue: Finish the forward shift and let the two arms settle apart.
steps.chineseCue: 完成向前的重心移动，双臂在分开的位置落稳。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 19.3-19.8s show the completed forward stance with separated arms.

steps.title: Round 2: sit back and turn foot
steps.cue: Move back onto the rear leg and turn the front foot.
steps.chineseCue: 身体后移到后腿，前脚随转体调整方向。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 20.8-21.3s front knee straightens and front toes lift as the body moves back.

steps.title: Round 2: gather the rear foot
steps.cue: Turn forward again and bring the rear foot in while the arms circle.
steps.chineseCue: 身体再次转向前方，后脚收近，双臂同时绕回。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 22.3s body passes forward; 22.8-23.3s rear foot lifts and travels close to the standing leg.

steps.title: Round 2: lift and reach heel
steps.cue: Lift the stepping knee, then extend the heel ahead with the arms rounded.
steps.chineseCue: 迈步腿提起后向前伸跟，保持身前围合的双臂。

steps.title: Round 2: shift and separate
steps.cue: Move into the new front leg while opening the front arm and lowering the rear hand.
steps.chineseCue: 身体移向新的前腿，前臂打开，后手下落。

steps.title: Round 2: finish the stance
steps.cue: Finish opening the two arms and settle into the forward stance.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂继续分开，完成前腿弯曲的站姿。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 27.3-28.3s show the front arm extended and the rear hand lowered.

steps.title: Round 3: sit back and turn foot
steps.cue: Shift back and adjust the front foot before the next step.
steps.chineseCue: 重心后移，前脚调整方向，准备再迈步。

steps.title: Round 3: gather foot and arms

steps.title: Round 3: reach with the heel

steps.title: Round 3: shift and separate

steps.title: Round 3: finish the stance
steps.cue: Finish the forward stance with the arms apart.

steps.title: Bring the rear foot closer

steps.title: Round 1: brush and push

steps.boundaryEvidence: 151.0-151.95s show the open final stance.

steps.title: Begin the cloud turn
steps.cue: Turn across the front, keeping one arm high as the other lowers.
steps.chineseCue: 身体转过正面，一臂保持高位，另一臂下绕。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 152.0s arms are spread; 154.0s body faces nearer the front and one arm lowers.

steps.title: Shift across and circle
steps.cue: Move across the open stance while the arms trade high and low paths.
steps.chineseCue: 身体在开立站姿间横移，双臂交换一高一低的路径。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 155.0s body turns to the other side and arms have traded height.

steps.title: Bring the trailing foot in
steps.cue: Draw the trailing foot close while continuing the arm circles.
steps.chineseCue: 后随的脚收近，双臂继续绕动。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 156.0s trailing foot moves inward; 157.0s feet are close.

steps.title: Finish the circle with feet close
steps.cue: Keep the feet close as the upper arm crosses the front.
steps.chineseCue: 双脚收近，较高的手臂经过身前。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 157.0-158.0s feet stay close as hands complete the circle.

steps.title: Step out with the next circle
steps.cue: Lift the stepping foot and place it sideways while the arms circle.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂绕动时，迈步脚提起并向侧面落下。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 159.0s knee lifts; 160.0s foot extends sideways.

steps.title: Shift across the open stance
steps.cue: Move across the open feet and exchange the high and low arms.

steps.boundaryEvidence: 161.0s feet are wide; 162.0s weight travels across and trailing foot starts moving in.

steps.title: Bring the trailing foot in
steps.cue: Bring the following foot close while the arms keep circling.
steps.chineseCue: 后随的脚收近，双臂继续绕动。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 162.0-163.0s trailing foot travels toward the other foot.

steps.title: Finish the circle with feet close
steps.cue: Keep the narrowed stance as one arm passes in front.
steps.chineseCue: 保持收近的站距，一臂经过身前。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 164.0s feet are close with hands passing in front.

steps.title: Take the next sideways step
steps.cue: Lift and place the stepping foot sideways as the arms circle.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂绕动时，迈步脚再次提起并向侧面落下。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 165.0s stepping knee lifts; 166.0s foot reaches out sideways.

steps.title: Shift across and exchange arms

steps.title: Gather the following foot

steps.boundaryEvidence: 168.0s trailing foot lifts inward; 169.0s feet are close.

steps.title: Finish the final cloud circle

steps.chineseCue: 双脚收近，双臂完成经过身前的绕动。
steps.boundaryEvidence: 169.0-170.25s feet remain close while arms finish crossing the front.

steps.title: Gather the arms in front

steps.title: Lift the knee and extend the arm

steps.title: Place the heel and open

steps.title: Finish the wide stance
